name: Tasmania
summary_text: The country dossier documents no state-specific statute, incident series or enforcement pattern for Tasmania. The one divergence a detained visitor could meet is custody placement: Tasmania is one of four jurisdictions (with New South Wales, Victoria and the capital territory) that place trans prisoners on an explicit self-identification basis, whereas elsewhere in the country placement turns on surgical status or case-by-case assessment.
